attributes.name: data-total-pages
attributes.description: how many pages the host believes there are. The grid reads it and never writes it: a Find steps past the last page by it, and a count that has not changed is not reported again, so the echo of its own report cannot loop. JS API — what a person can do by clicking, a caller can do by calling. This is what lets a SAVED VIEW, a preset or an agent configure a grid: setColumnFilter(field, clause)  set one column's filter from a store FilterClause columnClause(field)            read it back — the same clause, for saving suspendColumnFilter(field, on) keep the clause but stop applying it clearColumnFilter(field?)      delete one, or all openColumnFilter(field, anchor) open that column's menu, anchored anywhere select(keys) / clearSelection() set the selection BY KEY (needs `key` in populate) actionsFor(count)              the actions that apply to a selection of that size — all of them for 1, only the `multi` ones for 2+, none for 0. A bulk toolbar reads this so it cannot disagree with the row menu selectedKeys / selectedRecords read it back

"Organise" is not a kind; it is a heading a panel may draw above the two. tags.name: sherpa-stack
tags.description: a run of controls in one direction, with a token gap. A layout surface: no chrome, fill, border or padding. Bordered box = sherpa-container; two-zone action strip = sherpa-toolbar.

attributes.name: data-align
attributes.description: start | center | end | stretch | between — how items sit ACROSS the run (the cross axis), except `between`, which spreads them ALONG it

attributes.name: data-direction
attributes.description: block | inline (a row)

attributes.name: data-fill
attributes.description: take the parent's height and hand the spare space to the child marked data-grow. Without it the stack is content-height and there is no spare space to give.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: sm (4) | md (8) | lg (12, default) | xl (16) | 2xl (24)

attributes.name: data-grow
attributes.description: with data-fill on the stack, this item takes the spare space and the others keep their natural size. Two attributes, not one: a stack cannot see its own children from CSS — `:host(:has(…))` does not parse, and `:host:has(…)` matches every host.

attributes.name: data-measure
attributes.description: cap the run's width at a reading measure (90ch) and centre it On a CHILD (not on the stack):

attributes.name: data-min-item
attributes.description: with data-wrap: hug — each item at its OWN width (a run of chips); else the floor an item may shrink to while it STRETCHES to share the line — sm (120) | md (200, default) | lg (280) | xl (360)

attributes.name: data-scroll
attributes.description: the run scrolls when it is taller than its room, instead of pushing the page. It caps the stack at its parent's height, so the parent must have one.

attributes.name: data-wrap
attributes.description: inline only: items wrap and share the line

tags.name: sherpa-switch
tags.description: an immediate binary toggle.

attributes.name: data-description
attributes.description: a helper line under the label

attributes.name: data-label
attributes.description: its words, beside the track — a click on them toggles it, as on a checkbox

attributes.name: data-type
attributes.description: default (rectangular, ON/OFF label, square thumb) | simple  (pill, no label, round thumb)

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: native boolean       (current value; drives :checked visuals)

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: native boolean       (reflected onto the inner input)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: native string        (what a form submits it under)

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: native boolean       (a form refuses it while off)

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: native string        (what it stands for when on; default "on")

tags.name: sherpa-tabs
tags.description: a tabbed content switcher.

attributes.name: data-current-id
attributes.description: id of the currently active tab / panel

tags.name: sherpa-tag
tags.description: a compact labelled pill. Colour comes from the [data-status] cascade on an ancestor, not from the tag itself.

attributes.name: data-dismissible
attributes.description: show the close button (fires tag-dismiss)

attributes.name: data-icon
attributes.description: leading icon glyph value (shown when present; or slot "icon")

attributes.name: data-status
attributes.description: info | success | warning | critical | urgent (via the cascade)

attributes.name: data-type
attributes.description: dot   (render as a small circular indicator; default full)

tags.name: sherpa-toast
tags.description: a transient notification (Figma Toast 27:750). The card is NEUTRAL, not status-filled; only the icon badge carries the hue.

attributes.name: data-action
attributes.description: an action link label (shown when present; fires toast-action)

attributes.name: data-duration
attributes.description: auto-dismiss delay in ms (default 5000; 0 disables)

attributes.name: data-heading
attributes.description: the primary line (or the default slot)

attributes.name: data-status
attributes.description: info | success | warning | critical | urgent

attributes.name: data-value
attributes.description: the supporting detail line (shown when present)

tags.name: sherpa-toolbar
tags.description: a horizontal control strip: leading zone hugs, trailing grows.

attributes.name: data-density
attributes.description: comfortable | compact (tighter block padding)

attributes.name: data-type
attributes.description: plain | bordered (adds a bottom rule)

tags.name: sherpa-tooltip
tags.description: a hover/focus tooltip wrapping a trigger.

attributes.name: data-anchor
attributes.description: a selector for the box it describes, when it does not wrap one

attributes.name: data-placement
attributes.description: top | bottom | left | right

attributes.name: data-text
attributes.description: tip text (or use the `tip` slot)

tags.name: sherpa-transfer-list
tags.description: a two-pane shuttle (available ↔ selected). Pool comes from populate([{ value, label, selected? }]); `selected` picks the pane.

attributes.name: data-source-heading
attributes.description: heading for the available pane

attributes.name: data-target-heading
attributes.description: heading for the selected pane

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: disabled state — no move is made

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: the form field its selected values are submitted under
